name: Kilayim of Seeds and Plants (Kilei Zeraim)
notes: Rules against sowing mixed seeds in a field; minimum separations, bed arrangements, and species that do or do not constitute kilayim with one another

name: Kilayim in a Vineyard — Detailed Rules (Kilei haKerem)
notes: Detailed laws of sowing grain or vegetables near vines: required distances, karahat, mehol, aris, and what causes sanctification/prohibition of seed or vine

name: Kilayim of Clothing — Shatnez (כלאי בגדים / שעטנז)
notes: Prohibition of wearing wool and linen mixtures; what constitutes shatnez (spinning, weaving, combing); application to garments, mattresses, shrouds, packsaddles, sellers and tailors

name: Kilayim of Animals in Work (Kilei Beheimah b'Avodah)
notes: Prohibition of yoking, plowing, pulling, or leading together two different species of animals; includes liability for driver and passenger

name: Definition and Structure of a Vineyard (Tzurat haKerem)
notes: What constitutes a valid halachic vineyard: minimum rows and vines, layout patterns (two-opposite-two with tail), poor vineyard, ruined vineyard

name: Karahat and Mehol of a Vineyard
notes: Required minimum dimensions of bare patches (karahat) and border spaces (mehol) in a vineyard to permit sowing; dispute between Bet Shammai and Bet Hillel

name: Aris (Espalier Vineyard)
notes: Laws of vines trained along a fence or trellis (aris): required working-space, gaps in an aris, vines suspended over trees, projecting tendrils and blossoms

name: Bending and Conducting a Vine Underground (Havrakas haGefen)
notes: Rules for a vine bent into the ground and re-emerging elsewhere; soil cover required, measuring from the second root, combining of bent vines

name: Flowerpot (Atzitz) in Kilayim Context
notes: Whether a perforated vs. non-perforated flowerpot carried through a vineyard creates kilayim prohibition

name: Species Classification for Kilayim Purposes
notes: Determining which plant and animal species are considered the 'same species' or 'different species' for kilayim law; domesticated vs. wild variants; behemah vs. hayyah classification

name: Sanctification (Prohibition) of Kilayim Produce in Vineyard
notes: When kilayim of the vineyard takes effect; what causes the seed and vine to become prohibited; forbidden benefit vs. merely forbidden sowing; from which growth stage prohibition begins

name: Grafting (Harkavah) in Kilayim
notes: Prohibition of grafting between different species: tree on tree, vegetable on vegetable, tree on vegetable; dispute of Rabbi Judah regarding vegetable on tree

name: Sowing Multiple Species in Garden Beds (Arugot)
notes: Rules for sowing up to five or thirteen different species in a small garden bed using borders; required dimensions of furrow and border to separate species
